title: Damned If You Do...
summary: A man from the Saint Marie Heritage Society is found poisoned.
method: Everyone ate from the same bowl of stew which contained a poisonous plant as an ingredient. The killer applied a concentrated version to the journal pages of the victim so that it was fatal for him.
motive: The killer was discovered for stealing money from the society and also felt sorry for the killer's son, who was having trouble adapting to live in Saint Marie.
killer: One of the heritage society members
notes:
This is when Camille announces that she has an offer to join the police force in Paris.
I don't understand why there was a need to have poison in the stew if there was a concentrated version applied to the journal pages.
